_about: Thirty rewordings of the Thornwood questions in tasks_apparel_v2.json, written by the
verifier on 20 October 2026 in its audit of the box, without looking at the regular
expressions the rules parse with, and run by it through box.decide at commit 3843e20.
Copied from the audit's script by value, nothing retyped: id is the audit's number, text
the question as it wrote it, template the task it rewords, label its own judgement where
it gave one (clear or ambiguous; null where it wrote -), and audit_expected the outcome
its script expected of box.decide, in its words: a plan's kind, ASK or REFUSE. That is
the template's own outcome on every question but 10 and 29, where the audit expected a
refutation and the template is asked back on (tests/test_probe.py checks this).
The audit put each question to the box as the lead, a space and the text, on the
Thornwood results page as the box read it in batch page_from, every row of whose
suite.json holds the same page record. runners/parse_probe.py --questions does the same,
Not tuned: no question has been edited since the audit ran it, and no rule has been
changed to parse one. A rule written because of one of them makes the set in sample, so
a later set goes in a new file rather than an edit of this one (LESSONS 19).
No answer keys: no agent runs on these. They measure parsing only, the rules' form and
the model's form of each against the rules' form of its template.
